summary: Case 3 re-verification (Country defaults to India). All three sub-cases PASS: (a) New Lead popup select data-testid=create-lead-country defaults to 'India' and can be changed. (b) Existing lead with NO country in DB (TEST_country_default) shows 'India' in Contact card display AND field-input-country dropdown is pre-selected to 'India' in edit mode. (c) Lead with explicit non-India country (TEST_country_us => 'United States') is NOT overridden — shows real value. (d) Changing country to 'Nepal' on TEST_country_default and saving persists after reload (display + edit both show 'Nepal').

critical_code_review_comments: FieldCard.save compares draft[k] against lead[k] only, so if the user opens Edit on an empty-country lead and clicks Save without touching Country, nothing is written and the field remains empty in DB — which is correct (display default is UI-only). This is the intended behavior of the current fix; flagging for awareness only.
